instrument: Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 (UK261, as retained in UK law), Article 7(1)(a)
cite_en: Under Article 7(1)(a) of Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 as retained in UK law, passengers on a flight of 1,500 kilometres or less are entitled to fixed compensation of 220 pounds sterling where arrival at the final destination is delayed by three hours or more. instrument: 14 CFR Part 260 (DOT automatic refund rule), section 260.2 significant change definition
cite_en: Under 14 CFR § 260.2 of the Department of Transportation automatic refund rule, a carrier must refund the ticket price to a passenger on an international flight that is significantly changed, which includes a departure or arrival delay of six hours or more, where the passenger declines the alternative offered.
